evidence.reason: Line 177 substitutes both `%i` and `%I` with the escaped instance text. Under systemd unit-specifier semantics `%i` is the escaped instance while `%I` is the unescaped instance, so an instance such as `crq\x2dtick` should expand `%I` to `crq-tick`. Using the escaped text for `%I` prevents the scanned reference from resolving to the actual target unit. This is an ordinary implementation defect in the existing expansion behavior, not a proposal to expand scope.
